- **Why:** a per-seat rate can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so a mail to him with the $2,101 Thornbury rate needs Anselm's or June's approval first, even though you own the account.
- **What I did:**
  - Logged the approval request, naming June.
  - Sent June a direct message asking whether I can go ahead. That message leaves out the rate itself.
  - Replied to Marcus in his direct message to explain the hold.
- **Once June approves:** I'll save the draft in Marcus's mailbox, addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", and he'll send it himself.
- **Other options I gave Marcus:** ask Anselm for approval instead, or send Hollis a version without the rate.

I couldn't confirm that Marcus owns Thornbury, because no Thornbury account files are visible to him. That doesn't change anything here, since the approval is needed because Hollis isn't one of the allowed recipients.
